entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-sodamem
entry.summary: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved. Exact install spec: dsh-plugin-sodamem. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
